articles.txt:
Spoiler alert: This post contains a few details about the game.
I was pleasantly surprised when I first booted up GTA 6 not to be greeted by a further download, after Sony warned PlayStation users that an update would be required before they could play the game.
The game's prologue provides backstory for the protagonists, Jason and Lucia, as well as a lush advertisement for its sprawling world, with neon lights, swimming pools and aeroplanes.
Transitions between cutscenes and gameplay are seamless. The graphics are so crisp in places that you can see the pores on characters' faces and individual hairs bouncing as they walk.
However, I did notice a slight drop in frame rate during an early chase scene following a robbery. It's a flaw already being pointed out in early reviews of the game, but it could also be because I'm playing on an Xbox Series S, Microsoft's budget version of the flagship Series X console.
Despite this, the world feels incredibly vibrant as you cut through the water in a speedboat beneath the Leonida sun - in stark contrast to the dark backdrop of the UK on a November morning.

articles.txt:
Recevez tous les soirs un résumé de l’actu importante avec Le Récap’
Rockstar Games a repensé quelques fondations du gameplay de sa saga phare avec GTA 6 , disponible depuis ce jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5, Xbox Series S et Xbox Series X. Il y a notamment une petite révolution sur la touche attribuée à la course. Dans GTA 5 comme dans Red Dead Redemption 2 , il fallait marteler la touche Croix (PlayStation) ou A (Xbox) pour que son personnage accélère . Maintenant, par défaut, un simple clic sur le stick gauche (L3 sur PS5, LS sur Xbox) suffit.
Ce choix pourra faire jaser certains aficionados de la série, qui tapent sur Croix ou A par réflexe depuis des années. Rockstar Games a prévu le coup. Dès la configuration initiale, avant de se lancer dans GTA 6 , un écran prévient : « Les commandes par défaut pour GTA VI utilisent désormais [l’appui sur le stick gauche] pour courir et sprinter, mais peuvent être modifiées à tout moment. L’interface et le système de jeu sont également entièrement personnalisables selon vos préférences . »
Configuration des commandes dans GTA 6 // Source : Capture Xbox Trois schémas de contrôle pour la course dans GTA 6 Pour modifier la configuration de la manette, il suffit de se rendre dans les paramètres de GTA 6 , dans le premier onglet, « Configuration des commandes ».
Configuration des commandes dans GTA 6 // Source : Capture Xbox On peut changer de schéma à tout moment, depuis le menu pause. Mieux vaut essayer les trois schémas pour trouver celui qui vous convient le mieux. Celui par défaut a le mérite d’assouplir grandement l’expérience, quand bien même il rompt avec une tradition bien ancrée dans la mémoire musculaire.
Sortie GTA 6 : les premiers joueurs arrivent dans Leonida (infos, images et premières astuces en direct) Configuration des commandes dans GTA 6 // Source : Capture Xbox Rockstar s’aligne ainsi, avec des années de retard, sur la plupart des jeux d’action en monde ouvert, qui ont depuis longtemps mis la course sur le stick gauche. GTA 5 (2013) comme Red Dead Redemption 2 (2018) gardaient le martèlement de Croix ou A par défaut. Le gain est concret : tant que le pouce droit tape sur un bouton, il ne peut pas tourner la caméra avec le stick droit.

articles.t: GTA 6 animals guide: What you can spot, pet, hunt, and fish for in Leonida
articles.chapeau: You can pet cats, log bird sightings, and go fishing across Rockstar's fictional version of Florida. Oh, and get eaten by an alligator.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI launches Nov. 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, and as the game unlocks around the world , players are already sharing clips of their first encounters with the local wildlife.
Beyond the streets of Vice City, Leonida — Rockstar's fictional take on Florida — is home to more than 170 animal species according to Game Informer , from alligators ( that can eat you! ) and manatees to jellyfish and dogs of several breeds. That's a massive jump from the roughly 28 species in GTA 5 . Some are there to spot and log in your wildlife journal, while others invite you to stop and interact — and some can even become your pets.
Here's what we know about the animals in GTA 6 so far, and what you can do when you find them.
The wildlife in Leonida gets pretty specific to Florida. There are the animals you'd probably expect, like flamingos, manatees, and alligators, plus a few that might surprise you, like green iguanas, cane toads, and rhesus macaques. Yes, Florida really does have monkeys. And if you head up to Mount Kalaga, it’s worth stopping to see what’s going on around you. One of Rockstar's screenshots shows a cougar stalking a group of deer, so mind your surroundings.
So far, people have spotted everything from armadillos, beavers, and raccoons to black bears, bobcats, and boars. There are also foxes, otters, skunks, squirrels, frogs, turtles, and snakes, plus cows, horses, cats, and dogs. And if you're the kind of person who stops to pet every dog you pass, there are already reports of Australian shepherds, Chihuahuas, Dobermans, German shepherds, Labradors, and Rottweilers.
There's plenty to look for along the water, too. Think pelicans, herons, and spoonbills, along with ducks, gulls, cormorants, cranes, and those flamingos. Eagles, pigeons, storks, and woodpeckers have also turned up. In the water itself, sightings range from crayfish, eels, and jellyfish to dolphins, sea turtles, manta rays, hammerhead sharks, and whales. If you go scuba diving off the Leonida Keys, some of the marine life even glows .
A few sightings are still up for debate. GTABase lists possums and rats, for example, while IGN left both off its list.
If you pass by an adorable cat or dog, you can pet both. Petting a cat actually gives Jason a small focus boost, and if a dog's owner gives you permission, you can give it a treat. Some gas stations sell pet treats, according to The Guardian , and you also have the option to praise or scold either animal.
You can also run into a cat while stealing a car. In one clip, Jason drives off, hears loud meowing, and suddenly has a cat lunging at him. A timed button prompt lets him fend it off, and from there, you can pull over and let the cat out or keep driving. As one user put it, "Cats Are Now Gangsters."
Apparently, dogs in Leonida like jet skis, too. One player in a post on X swam out to see how far they could get from shore and found a dog sitting on a jet ski that users can ride with. How it got out there is anybody's guess.
Back on dry land, Jason has a pet of his own. Dolores, a snake, lives at his house in the Leonida Keys, and feeding her a mouse gives him a small focus boost. So far, she's the only pet Jason can keep in the story, according to Cultured Vultures .
You can also keep track of the animals you see. Open the weapon wheel, select your binoculars, and zoom in on an animal. Then hold R1 on PlayStation or RB on Xbox to add it to your wildlife logbook. There are 62 types of birds to spot, as we covered in our GTA 6 birdwatching guide , and different breeds of cats and dogs get their own entries. Studying any 100 of the 255 entries counts toward 100 percent completion, according to PowerPyx .
There's also a zoo to visit, and you can go fishing or hunting. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told YouTuber TGG that fishing is catch-and-release, so every fish goes back in the water, even during a challenge, as GameSpot reported .
Hunting is a way to earn money. Jason's old Army friend Bret Vogel teaches him how to track deer before sending him after other animals. Some hunting challenges spell out exactly what to look for. According to the outlet, some send players after a boar, a rattlesnake, and a panther.

articles.t: GTA 6 est maintenant disponible
articles.chapeau: C'est historique, Grand Theft Auto VI est officiellement disponible sur PS5, Xbox Series et Xbox One via le Cloud !
articles.txt:
Sur Rockstar Mag, il y a des articles qui font parfois date. Celui-ci en fera partie, sans aucun doute. Avec énormément de joie, et une pointe déjà, de nostalgie, nous vous annonçons que, le graal, le monstre sacré, le jeu-vidéo le plus attendus de tout les temps, GTA 6 est officiellement disponible, ce 19 novembre 2026.
Oui enfin ! Enfin ! GTA 6 est officiellement disponible. A partir d’aujourd’hui, plus précisément depuis minuit heure de Paris, vous (et nous) allez pouvoir commencer les aventures de Jason et Lucia dans l’Etat de Leonida , et bien sûr arpenter les rues (une nouvelle fois pour les plus anciens) de la métropole de Vice City . GTA VI est donc disponible sur Playstation 5, Xbox Series X et S, mais aussi sur Xbox One à l’aide du Cloud gaming (et avec les capacités techniques d’une Series S).
Cela fait plus de 13 ans depuis que le précédent opus, Grand Theft Auto V est sorti sur PS3 et Xbox 360 . Voilà aussi plus de 8 ans qu’un jeu Rockstar Games inédit n’était pas sorti, depuis Red Dead Redemption 2 en octobre 2018…
On peut maintenant prendre une grande inspiration et mettre les mains sur GTA 6. Une page se tourne, une autre se dévoile pour Rockstar Games, et pour toute la communauté de fans.
On ne vous retiens pas plus longtemps, foncez découvrir le jeu !

articles.t: Ces ligériens ont posé un jour pour jouer à GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Certains Ligériens se sont arrangés avec leurs collègues pour ne pas travailler aujourd'hui, d'autres ont carrément posé un jour de repos.
articles.txt:
Cela faisait treize ans que les fans l'attendaient. Après plus de huit ans de développement par Rockstar, le jeu vidéo GTA 6 est officiellement sorti cette nuit. Il est présenté comme l'un des plus grands jeux vidéo de tous les temps. Si vous faites partie des "boomers", il s'agit en fait d’un jeu d’action où il faut incarner un criminel afin de gravir les échelons du milieu et de se faire un nom dans le grand banditisme en accomplissant des missions. Pour ce faire, il est possible de tuer des gens, voler des voitures, ou encore griller des feux rouges.
Alors que le magazine américain Forbes salue " l'univers de jeu vidéo le plus impressionnant " jamais créé, a ux États-Unis, on craint notamment des millions d’euros de pertes en termes de productivité, entre ceux qui ont posé un jour et ceux qui vont présenter un arrêt maladie à leur employeur. Dans la Loire aussi, chez nous, certains ont déjà banalisé cette journée du 19 novembre depuis longtemps. C’est le cas de Fabien, qui a anticpé : " J'avais échangé avec un collègue pour me remplacer, car cela fait un moment que j'attends le jeu. C'est énorme " lance-t-il, impatient de découvrir le jeu. Jemil aussi veut profiter de son jeudi pour jouer à GTA 6. Le ligérien fait partie de ceux qui ont posé un jour : " Pour moi, ce n'est pas juste la sortie d'un jeu vidéo, c'est un véritable événement. On a grandi avec GTA 5 et aujourd'hui, on va enfin découvrir un nouvel univers. Je suis tellement impatient que j'ai même posé un jour de repos spécialement pour pouvoir jouer tranquillement. Après treize ans d'attente, Rockstar a intérêt à nous régaler " lance, tout sourire, le jeune homme.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' on Xbox Series S: How well it actually runs
articles.chapeau: Here's the verdict.
articles.txt:
Reading through Reddit, there is no shortage of concerns about how well Xbox Series S will or won’t run the game. As the release neared, fans seemed confident that Rockstar Games would ensure the game was playable, but opinions varied widely on what graphical sacrifices would be required for it to run, including reduced crowd density and scaled-back visuals.
How much time did I spend sweating the idea of crowd density? Too much. Did I ever think about it or care about it until Redditors said it’ll likely be less on the Series S? Not at all.
And yet, while it filled me with regret for not buying a PS5 last Black Friday before the price hikes arrived, it did not stop me from buying GTA 6 on Xbox Series S, debating whether or not to resist the pull off the New Zealand timezone trick to play it early, and preparing to explore Leonida.
And now, having played GTA 6 for a few hours, I can tell you everything you need to know about how it runs and how it feels.
I won’t keep you waiting: GTA 6 runs smooth as butter on Xbox Series S. There were no stutters, no lag or other slowdowns that pulled me out of the gameplay.
During a prologue that introduced me to protagonists Jason and Lucia, I quickly experienced a variety of locations in daytime and nighttime, as well as rainy weather. After that, I was able to play around Leonida and check out all the basic things that might catch your attention as you play: how the weather looks, flying down the road in a car through busy streets, random tasks around Jason's home.
In addition to moving quickly through various areas, I also took a moment to slow down. I watched a sunset by the water, went for a swim surrounded by fish, and observed how the environment affected Jason. Nothing slowed down, glitched out, or made me think anything other than I was playing a AAA game.
What I can’t tell you right now is how much better GTA 6 is or isn’t on PS5 or any of the higher-end consoles. We’re in the process of comparing the Xbox Series S version to the PS5 Pro version as we speak.
Rockstar has explicitly said the game will run best on PS5 consoles, with faster load times and technology that may improve resolution. The PS5 Pro version will also include ray tracing, making the lighting even more eye-catching. But both games will still be locked at 30 frames per second, according to Rockstar. The game developer did not say if any other sacrifices had to be made to get it to run on the Xbox Series S.
Regardless, what I can tell you is there is a good game waiting for you to play on Xbox Series S. If you don’t have the funds to upgrade your console, do not let comparison be the thief of joy.
GTA 6 is a generational moment in gaming and a cultural moment much larger than any game launch I’ve ever seen. The game is fun, the music is a vibe, and the world is immersive without feeling like a chore. I can't imagine waiting to play this if they have the means to do so right now.

0 Photo Illustrations - Grand Theft Auto VI ©Getty GTA 6 is set to be released soon, ending the thirteen-year wait . The album from the sixth game leaked online and consists of a staggering 34 tracks. If the leaked soundtrack is to be believed, the music album might be just as ambitious as the sixth game.
It looks like you will hear chart-topping numbers by artists like Jennie, Dua Lipa, and Lana Del Rey. Moreover, the radio stations will play songs by Bad Bunny in GTA 6 . This revelation has fans even more hyped for the sixth game.
Rockstar Games had confirmed in September that it will release the GTA 6 soundtrack in CD and vinyl alongside the game. Billboard published all 34 tracks that are a part of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album . The full tracklist looks like this:
Sexy Magic - CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Étienne de Crécy
Flower in a Hurricane - Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA & King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
Overtown Lights - Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes & Robert Glasper
Apart from the tracks above, Cocoteo FM, one of the fictional radio stations in the world of GTA, will play songs by artists like RaiNao and Bad Bunny.
The original score of GTA 6 is credited to the popular French electronic band, Justice. The launch trailer heavily featured the band's new number, "Flower in a Hurricane," which also featured the vocals of SZA, Tame Impala, and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. "Flower in a Hurricane" is a fitting song for Vice City, a fictional setting known for being vibrant.
Justice's disco music and distorted synths will work in the game as you navigate Vice City as Jason or Lucia. The official logline of the game reads:
"Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive."
The GTA 6 album releases on November 19, 2026, alongside the game.

articles.t: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Learn how to make money fast in GTA 6 Chapters 1 and 2 with Illegal Operations, stolen car sales, and sunken treasure.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google Money can be tight at the start of Grand Theft Auto VI , especially when you need cash to progress the story. Here’s how to make money fast in GTA 6 , including where to find your first Illegal Operation and when you can start selling parked cars.
The fastest way to make money in GTA 6 Chapters 1 and 2 is to steal narcotics from Illegal Operations and sell them to Brian or Donnie in Chapter 1, or Dunk in Chapter 2. You can also sell stolen cars for quick cash or go treasure diving with Kenton for a payout later in the Grand Theft Auto VI’s story .
In Chapter 1, Key Lento has one main Illegal Operation called Exotic Animals Front . You can also access two Kingfisher Illegal Operations in the swamps to the northwest, Fishing Shacks and Manatee Hotel .
To get into Exotic Animals Front, find the Three Sheets Liquor store in the middle of Key Lento. From the front of the store, head around the right side of the building and wrap around until you are on the backside of it.
You will eventually find a hole in the wall you can climb through. Take out the three enemies inside, then head into the back room.
Once inside of the Exotic Animals Front backroom, there’s a safe you can break open for cash without a code.
After you reach Port Gellhorn in Chapter 2, La Cascara Motel is one of the best Illegal Operations for earning money. For the fastest payout in either chapter, grab any narcotics you find during these operations and sell them to Brian or Donnie in Chapter 1 or Bunk in Chapter 2 .
Make sure to check out our guide on All GTA 6 Safe Codes in Chapter 2 to make even more money quickly.
In Chapter 1, you can steal cars driving down the street and sell them at any Pay and Spray . There’s a limit to how many cars you can sell there every 24 in-game hours, so it’s a good way to earn some extra cash between Illegal Operations.
In Chapter 2, befriending Moses unlocks the ability to “Jimmy” open parked cars. Moses also has no daily limit on how many cars you can sell him, making this a more reliable way to earn money once you reach Port Gellhorn.
Visiting Kenton in Key Lento unlocks treasure hunting. You’ll get access to his boat and a scanner you can use to locate sunken treasure while diving.
Tracking down the treasure can take a while, and Kenton only pays you after he sells the valuables. That can take a few hours after you hand them over.
The payout is sizable once it comes through, so this is worth doing while you progress the story if you already have enough cash for your next mission. Overall these are the best methods to make money fast in GTA 6’s early chapters .
Although in Chapter 2 you will eventually unlock the ability to rob stores, including gas stations and jewelry stores. However, this is tied to main story progression.

articles.chapeau: Disponible depuis minuit ce jeudi 19 novembre, GTA 6 a conquis les fans qui ont joué dès sa sortie. Entre la diversité des missions, les graphismes réussis et les multiples interactions possibles, le jeu est une grande réussite pour une large majorité des joueurs contactés par RMC.
articles.txt:
Disponible depuis minuit ce jeudi 19 novembre, GTA 6 a conquis les fans qui ont joué dès sa sortie. Entre la diversité des missions, les graphismes réussis et les multiples interactions possibles, le jeu est une grande réussite pour une large majorité des joueurs contactés par RMC. Certains ont mis le réveil cette nuit pour être à l'heure. Précisément à minuit, en France métropolitaine, pour tester GTA 6 . Six heures après, ce jeudi 19 novembre au petit matin, certains fans sont toujours devant leur console.
C'est le cas de Maxime et Enzo. Le premier, manette en main, est bien installé dans le canapé. Le second est celui qui a le plus joué cette nuit, malgré le début de ses cours à 13 heures.
"Le jeu est magnifique, vraiment, c'est la qualité d'un film, on a vraiment l'impression d'être dans un film", se réjouit Enzo. Il insiste "surtout" sur les "petites interactions" auxquelles "on ne s'attend pas", qui "rendent le jeu vraiment réaliste" et "immersif".
Le jeu a réuni de nombreux groupes d'amis. À Bordeaux, Jules et cinq de ses "meilleurs potes" se sont regroupés à minuit devant la télévision pour découvrir les premières images du jeu. Chacun à leur tour, ils se sont passé la manette.
Ils sont tous impressionnés par les détails du jeu. "Tu as vu la lumière des phares à cause de la pluie", remarque l'un d'entre eux. Le moment est rempli d'émotion. "C'est tous mes débuts de jeu vidéo avec mes potes, c'est vraiment le fait de se retrouver autour d'un jeu vidéo qui nous fait tous vibrer et qui nous rend dingue. Ça me tire un peu les larmes", avoue Jules, sourire jusqu'aux oreilles.
Tous les petits détails ont été méticuleusement développés par Rockstar Games, l'éditeur du jeu, qui a "posé les jalons de ce que doit être un jeu en mode ouvert", selon Brice N'Guessan, directeur de la rédaction de Jeux-vidéo magazine, avec des journalistes qui ont eu accès au jeu en avant-première pour leurs tests.
"Vous pouvez chasser, pécher, faire de la plongée, sauter en parachute, faire le plein. C'est la vie qui vous entoure, c'est ça qui est extraordinaire."
Fan de la licence, Gaëtan s'est lui aussi "levé plus tôt pour pouvoir en profiter" avant de se rendre au travail. "Je me suis levé à 2h au lieu de 4h", confie-t-il au micro du Morning RMC . "Le jeu est magnifique, aucun lag, les détails sont magnifiques."
Le plaisir est complet pour la grande majorité des joueurs. Il faut dire que le développement du jeu a nécessité énormément de temps. "Ce GTA 6 est en développement depuis onze ans, il a été réalisé par onze studios à travers le monde, 5.000 personnes ont travaillé sur ce jeu", avance Brice N'Guessan, qui n'hésite pas à affirmer qu'il représente "une vraie rupture" dans le monde du jeu vidéo.
L'invité du Morning : Brice N'Guessan - 19/11 6:04 "Quand vous consacrez autant de temps sur le développement d'un jeu, forcément vous arrivez à réaliser un jeu extrêmement réaliste, extrêmement abouti, où vous avez des interactions avec votre environnement qui vont très loin", détaille le directeur de la rédaction de Jeux-vidéo magazine.
La diversité du jeu ressort particulièrement. Comme tout bon GTA, il est possible d'aborder le jeu de plusieurs manières, dans le but de plaire à tous les types de joueur. Rockstar hints massive GTA 6 map saved room for future content
articles.chapeau: Single-player expansions, or an online mode perhaps?
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI is out in some parts of the world (Editor's note: Who's to say you don't live in New Zealand , too?). The early reviewers all say it's incredible , and according to Rockstar, there may be more to come.
That piece of reporting comes courtesy of Kotaku , whose reviewer Zack Zwiezen noted that he had played more than 130 hours of the game without ever visiting certain parts of the enormous GTA 6 map. These areas include a zoo and two large casinos (where gambling is apparently not allowed), and are never mentioned in the main story or any side missions.
According to Rockstar Games VP of design Stephen Donkin, the in-game map was built for more than just this initial launch period.
"The map has been built for the long term and with many factors in mind,” Donkin told Kotaku. "So there are a few areas on the map that give us options in the future should we have a gameplay or narrative need for them."
Donkin's response seems to indicate that there will be more content coming to GTA 6 in the future, which is not surprising in and of itself. It's only mildly surprising that Rockstar would openly acknowledge that fact on launch day ( in New Zealand , anyway). Where this gets interesting is that Donkin could be referring to a couple of different things, namely new single-player missions or a still-unannounced online mode .
GTA V rather infamously never got single-player DLC, despite Rockstar promising such a thing shortly after its launch in 2013. Instead, GTA Online became massively successful, and that took priority. GTA 6 could be an opportunity to right that wrong, or it could be a repeat of history.
In September, Games Informer published interviews with Rockstar leaders that revealed just how gargantuan the map really is.
Rockstar confirmed it's the largest map it's ever made, and roughly twice as big as the GTA 5 map and three times as big as the Red Dead Redemption 2 map. But it's not just about size. Rockstar said it's also much denser and includes more interior spaces gamers can explore.
The map currently has six main regions: Vice City, Leonida Keyes, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park, all inspired by different parts of Florida.

6 amazingly mundane things you can do in 'GTA 6'
articles.chapeau: They really thought of everything.
articles.txt:
For a lot of folks, Grand Theft Auto VI is an excuse to live out the life of a powerful criminal, or at least try to be the world's best virtual boyfriend . But for those of us who left the "rampaging through the streets in a tank" days behind us, it sounds like the game has a lot more to offer.
GTA 6 seems to be defined as much by its embrace of the mundane as anything else. Early reviews and Rockstar's previews have highlighted some of the seemingly countless, completely boring activities in the game. There are plenty of clips making the rounds, too, and with AI making fake gameplay easier to pass off as the real thing, we can't verify every video out there. Still, I’ve seen enough to know what I’ll be doing while everyone else is on their crime sprees.
One feature that some early GTA 6 launch coverage has highlighted is the ability for the protagonist Jason to fix up his house . This doesn't just have cosmetic benefits. Doing repairs can also earn Jason some goodwill with Lucia, his partner in crime and love interest.
That means part of GTA 6 's story will involve fixing a leaky roof, repairing a porch railing and stairs, and perhaps most excitingly, painting a bedroom wall. Yes, you can literally watch paint dry in GTA 6 . This is what I've always wanted.
Developer Rockstar Games has become especially good at rendering the natural world in its more recent games, and it sounds like GTA 6 takes this to the next level. One major example of that is that you can devote your time to bird-watching , if you want.
There are apparently 62 different kinds of birds in the game, and you can check them out with a pair of binoculars before recording them in a wildlife logbook. I'm not joking when I say I know at least one person in real life who will absolutely go through the effort of finding all 62 birds. Heck, I might do it, too.
One of my favorite real-life pastimes is staring at my phone for way too much of every day. Constantly switching between and refreshing the same three social media apps is sorta like putting my brain in a microwave, and I just can't stop doing it.
That's why I'm excited about the prospect of literally doing the same thing in GTA 6 . You can sit in bed and just look at fake social media apps, which is genuinely probably a better and healthier use of time than looking at real ones.
Dogs are wonderful. I love dogs, and I'm glad that petting them has become an expected mechanic in so many video games in recent years. The fact that you can pet dogs in GTA 6 is old news at this point.
But I'm also a lifelong cat guy, and video games don't give cats nearly as much attention. Rockstar must have read my mind because you can totally pet cats in GTA 6 .
You can bet your bottom dollar that I'll be doing that instead of robbing convenience stores.
Previous GTA games have given players the ability to watch things on TV. I'm old enough to remember watching Katt Williams do virtual stand-up in GTA 4 , for example.
But GTA 6 steps that up by introducing an original cartoon series called Macca & Friends that you can apparently watch entirely in-game. That is stupid enough that I might actually do it.
Last but certainly not least, there is one optional side activity that every good video game ought to have: fishing. And guess what? You can totally fish in GTA 6 .
What else needs to be said? Few things are more relaxing in real life and in virtual life than sitting back and doing some dang angling. I might crack open a cold one while doing this for maximum effect.

articles.chapeau: Critics hail GTA 6 as a 'masterpiece', 'spectacular', and an 'astonishing American epic'.

x whatsapp-stroke copylink google Add Al Jazeera on Google info A billboard announcing the release of the Grand Theft Auto VI video game is displayed near Times Square, on November 17, 2026, in New York [Yuki Iwamura/AP] By John Power Published On 19 Nov 2026 19 Nov 2026 Grand Theft Auto VI has launched to rave reviews, in one of the most hotly anticipated releases in gaming history.
Gamers got their hands on the latest instalment of the GTA franchise on Thursday, as critics hailed the open-world game as a “masterpiece”, “spectacular”, and an “astonishing American epic”.
The immersive game had an aggregate score of 99 out of 100 on Metacritic, based on more than 150 reviews, as it began dropping on game consoles worldwide from midnight.
“Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played,” critic Luke Reilly wrote in a gushing review for gaming website IGN.
“Accepting that GTA 6 is very much not real also makes it all the more astonishing how much the game is very real,” reviewer Jordan Minor wrote in PCMag.
Grand Theft Auto VI follows the exploits of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a Bonnie and Clyde-like duo who become entangled in a criminal conspiracy after a seemingly easy score goes awry.
Players have free rein to explore the hyper-realistic fictional state of Leonida and its coastal metropolis of Vice City, stand-ins for Florida and Miami.
Like previous entries in the series, Grand Theft Auto VI features graphic depictions of crime and violence, with players able to mow down pedestrians in stolen vehicles and engage in shootouts with police.
The game, developed by New York-based Rockstar Games at an estimated cost of more than $1bn, is the first instalment in the series since the release of Grand Theft Auto V in 2013.
Originally set to go on sale in 2025, the release was delayed twice to allow developers to polish up gameplay.
Grand Theft Auto VI, which is available on the PlayStation 5 and the Xbox Series, is likely to be the most lucrative release in the history of the gaming industry, which is estimated to be worth some $350bn annually.
Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI exceeded the estimated 15.8 million units as of November 17, generating $1.54bn in revenue, according to market intelligence platform Sensor Tower.
The GTA series began in 1997 with the launch of Grand Theft Auto, a 2D top-down open-world game available on the personal computer, PlayStation and Game Boy Color.

'GTA 6' on PC: What we know about the PC release
articles.chapeau: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' is the most-anticipated video game of all time.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI will be available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles at launch (it will also be available on Xbox Cloud Gaming , with limits).
GTA 6 has no confirmed PC release date. Given Rockstar's history with PC ports, we originally thought gamers were in for a long wait.
An October 2026 report from gaming business media site Gamesbeat reveals a potential PC launch in early 2027, which is sooner than we expected.
The highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on Nov. 19, 2026, but PC players will have to wait a while longer. Rockstar has confirmed that the game will not be available for PC gamers at launch, and no PC version has been officially announced yet.
Despite that, we recently got some good news: GamesBeat reports that GTA 6 will get a PC release sometime in Q1 of 2027. GamesBeat has a good track record with unannounced news like this. According to their reporting, the GTA 6 PC release window was confirmed by industry sources familiar with Rockstar's plans. They spoke with the outlet under the condition of anonymity.
Rockstar and Take-Two haven't given an official reason for skipping PC at launch, but a few factors are typically cited when publishers stagger releases this way.
Console hardware is standardized, which tends to make optimization more straightforward than building for the huge range of PC configurations. Some industry data has also indicated that consoles generate higher per-unit revenue, giving publishers an incentive to front-load console sales.
A more cynical take is that Take-Two could just be double-dipping, hoping fans who can't wait for the PC launch will buy the console first, then buy the PC version later. A PC Gamer poll found that 39 percent of respondents said they're fine waiting for a port rather than needing it on day one, suggesting a meaningful share of the PC audience isn't treating the delay as a dealbreaker.
However, there could be another, less financially motivated reason for all of this.
Speaking to YouTuber KiwiTalkz , former Rockstar producer John Ricchio explained that building for consoles first and scaling up to PC is technically easier than the reverse, since consoles have fixed, predictable hardware. According to IGN , Ricchio said it's simpler to start with tighter constraints and add polish later than to build a PC-first game and then try to trim it down to fit console limitations.
Without an official release date, gamers have had to speculate on the most likely launch window for a GTA 6 PC version.
If you look at several past Rockstar games, you can see that there's typically a significant amount of time between the console launch and the PC port.
Grand Theft Auto 4 was released in April 2008 and didn't reach PC's until December. Grand Theft Auto V was released in Sept. 2013, and its PC counterpart was released 19 months later in April 2015. Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived on PC roughly a year after its console release.
The one exception was Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition , which launched simultaneously across platforms in 2021. Based on that track record, a GTA 6 PC port, if it follows the usual pattern, could be a year or more away.
A report from The Verge claimed that Xbox would have exclusive rights to stream GTA 6 via its cloud gaming service at launch, a claim that was recently confirmed. The report noted that PC gamers would be able to play GTA 6 on day one , despite Rockstar's lack of news about a potential release window for a PC port. Unfortunately, Xbox Gaming's Chief Strategy Officer, Matthew Ball, shot down this report. Ball wrote on his personal X account that The Verge's coverage led to some "misreporting."
Again, the game will be available to play on Xbox consoles via Xbox Cloud Gaming, but that service faces strict monthly limits, which will make it difficult to play through the game in a timely fashion.
Fortunately, a GamesBeat report suggests gamers may not have to wait a full year for a PC release, though it remains unconfirmed.

Updated on Thursday, Nov. 19 at 12:57 p.m. ET — The PlayStation Service Status page now states that all services are up and running. This article has been updated to reflect PlayStation's current status.
Updated on Thursday, Nov. 19 at 12:41 p.m. ET — Sony has updated its PlayStation Service Status page to report issues with "Gaming and Social" systems for the PS5. A note reads, "You might have difficulty launching games, apps, or network features. We're working to resolve the issue as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience."
Many gamers have already taken advantage of a sneaky little trick that allowed them to play the long-awaited Grand Theft Auto VI one day early on New Zealand time. However, the vast majority of gamers in the U.S. waited for the official launch at midnight on Nov. 19 — and the big moment has finally arrived.
Unfortunately, the PlayStation servers may have temporarily gone down as countless gamers try to access the game all at once.
At 12:33 a.m. ET, Sony updated the official PlayStation Service Status page to reflect a possible outage. According to an update, game streaming on the PS4 and PS5 had been impacted, and gamers "might have difficulty launching games, apps, or network features."
Predictably, user error reports spiked sharply on the platform DownDetector right before midnight ET on Nov. 19, minutes before the official U.S. launch. Some social media users also reported problems accessing the PlayStation Network .
Up until midnight, the PlayStation status page showed that all systems were go for launch.
User error reports for PlayStation also spiked on DownDetector around 2 p.m. ET on Nov. 18, but the midnight increase was far larger. However, DownDetector only shows user-submitted error reports , not verified outages. And with countless gamers all firing up their PlayStations at once, user-side errors could be to blame.
Don't forget: You have to update your PlayStation console before you can play GTA 6.
With so many different companies and services suffering from outages recently, gamers may be understandably nervous. If you're encountering any issues with your console on launch day, here's how you can quickly check if there's really a PlayStation outage — or if it's just you and your internet connection.

articles.t: Rockstar Just Confirmed Where It Stands On The GTA 6 FPS Controversy - BGR
articles.chapeau: Rockstar's developers have made use of ray-traced reflections and shadows, as well as global illumination, which are too resource intensive for a 60 FPS game.
articles.txt:
Asanka Ratnayake/Getty Images Add BGR on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover If you're part of the "Grand Theft Auto 6" mob that's been waiting so eagerly for the groundbreaking game to launch, you may have already heard that dreams of playing the game in a silky-smooth 60 FPS mode have been dashed. This news has caused a great deal of frustration among gamers globally, but the truth is that there's so much detail in "GTA 6" that none of the current flagship consoles can handle a 60 FPS experience. The technology just doesn't exist to support it yet.
Rockstar revealed this disappointing bit of news earlier this month, but if you consider it from the game-maker's perspective, it makes sense. Rockstar's developers have made use of ray-traced reflections and shadows, as well as global illumination. Both concepts help create ultrarealistic lighting in games and simulate how real-world rays of light travel through a scene. Global illumination is a lighting technique that simulates how light interacts with objects, and ray tracing realistically simulates reflections and soft shadows. Right now, ray-traced shadows are only available to PlayStation 5 Pro gamers on "GTA 6."
When used together, these techniques are resource-heavy, so trying to add more frames per second to an already demanding simulation would only result in a degraded experience. Rockstar would have had to ensure smooth gameplay on different consoles, and because not even the best-in-class PS5 Pro can handle it, it was always going to crank the frame rates down to keep the experience immersive regardless of individual settings. You can turn off motion blur in "GTA 6" in settings to bring out the game's best level of detail, though.
iama_sing/Shutterstock The biggest limitation that causes "GTA 6" to hit a wall at 60 FPS on consoles is the CPU bottleneck. Sony is reportedly working on the PlayStation 6, and there have been leaks that suggest that the necessary CPU performance to run "GTA 6" at 60 FPS is built into the package. According to a leak published by Moore's Law is Dead on YouTube , Sony intends to upgrade the current Zen 2 CPU cores with a four-generation leap, reportedly going for Zen 6.
If this rumor turns out to be true, it could have cores dedicated to OS operations while reserving higher-performing cores for gaming. This will likely enable Rockstar to add a performance mode to "GTA 6" that would make 60 FPS gameplay available. The PS6 could land in about a year, reportedly lined up for a late 2027 or early 2028 launch.
Regardless of what leaks are suggesting, it will be in Sony's best interest to build a console that supports the most demanding games out there, and "GTA 6" has already set a pretty solid target that Sony can aim for. In the meantime, "GTA 6" is still worth playing on the Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 .

The trader bought $307 worth of the DCTY token shortly after it launched in October and has sold their bag for $202,278, according to DEX Screener, a profit of almost 66,000%.
Early indications had pointed to GTA 6 featuring an in-game meme coin—with, it's worth stressing, no actual blockchain element—called "DacityCoin," which appeared in the official launch trailer on a plane with a wing walker setting off a smoke bomb on top of it.
It was later linked to leaked gameplay of an mission which appeared to show game protagonist Lucia parachuting as a stunt to attract investment to DacityCoin .
Amid this hype, per DEX Screener, a real-world and unofficial DacityCoin launched using the Solana launchpad Pump.fun . It first peaked at a $4.95 million market capitalization, following the launch trailer's release, before tanking 93% to $343,620 as hype faded.
With GTA 6 set to launch within a matter of hours of publication, the token drew renewed attention, propelling it to a new all-time high of $10.8 million Wednesday. Unfortunately for investors, GTA 6's staggered global release means that some gamers are already playing it—and footage started to spread which suggested the Solana token's ticker was wrong.
The result was a rollercoaster of volatility, with the DacityCoin token now sitting at a market cap of around $800,000.
Gameplay footage from Brazilian streamer Combo Infinito suggests that the in-game token is called DacityCoin, with the ticker DCTY.
That propelled another Solana token with a seemingly accurate name and ticker sprang into action. DCTY's previous all-time high market cap was just $54,000 before the ticker was revealed, and it set a new high of over $12 million after footage of the game appeared to confirm that its ticker matched the in-game token. It is now trading at a market cap of around $10 million.
The game itself appears to be somewhat inconsistent in its naming of the in-game token. During the trailer, it appeared to be spelled "DacityCoin" as one word, however, the subtitles in the leak show it spelled as "Dacity coin," two words. Similarly, the company behind the in-game token is AudaCity, but leaks show three different spellings: Auda City, AudaCity, and Auda-City.
It is worth stressing: Rockstar has not explicitly confirmed that a meme coin will be featured in-game, and any real-world token has no official links to GTA 6 or its creators. Footage is still being released, and absolute confirmation of the in-game token's involvement is still being established.
Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
Those still holding the now-tanking DacityCoin are hoping things will turn around. Mike Lerro , the community takeover lead for DacityCoin, shrugged off any chance that the unofficial token's name and ticker are wrong.
"No, bro. DacityCoin and AudaCity are in the game. Yes or no?" When Decrypt suggested the ticker might be wrong, he replied, "It doesn't matter… Okay and ? The person who creates it will dump on you then it goes to zero. Who's gonna [do the community takeover]? No one."
"DACITYCOIN AND AUDACITY ARE IN THE GAME," Lerro wrote in the meme coin's Telegram. "NOTHING ELSE MATTERS."
"It's so crazy, it'll correct itself," Lerro said in an emergency Telegram group chat call. "I hope so," an investor replied.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 Pro performance jumps to 280 fps on PC, with DLSS 5 transforming Lucia
articles.chapeau: Capture cards and Nvidia DLSS give a glimpse of what a GTA 6 PC port may look like. In a GameGPU test, the PS5 Pro version sees frame rates rise from 30 to 280 fps. DLSS 5 neural rendering enhances lighting and shadows, but Lucia may be unrecognizable compared with trailer footage.
articles.txt:
As the release date arrived, Rockstar cast doubt on future performance upgrades for the flagship PlayStation console. With frame rates stuck at 30 fps , the GTA 6 PS5 Pro version prioritizes visual fidelity. A PC port lurks as a way to experience smoother graphics. Using capture software and NeuralScreen, new videos show what DLSS 5 and high-end hardware can do.
GameGPU recorded multiple clips via an AVerMedia Live Gamer Ultra 2.1 external capture card connected to the PS5 Pro. PC specs include an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU and an Nvidia RTX 5090 graphics card . At maximum settings, the console’s video output was set to 4K.
In a scene where Lucia is still in prison, DLSS 4.5 frame generation produces frame rates between 262 and 286 fps. Nevertheless, players may find the effects of DLSS 5 controversial.
Nvidia’s neural rendering adds detail to the GTA 6 PS5 Pro feed throughout the jail cell. With light entering a window, reflections and shadows look more natural. Lucia’s individual strands of hair become visible, but her face has undergone the most obvious transformation.
Without DLSS 5 active on the PC, the character resembles what fans have seen in official trailers . When on, Lucia’s face is photorealistic with varied textures and a different skin tone. Many critics worry that neural rendering distorts the original vision of developers and artists.
The second video depicts Jason standing on a dock during a swampland mission. Thanks to frame generation, readings jump to as high as 278 fps, and GTA 6 performance avoids stutters . Nvidia’s AI technology again improves the lighting and shadows in the outdoor scene. Jason’s clothes display ripples, and his beard stubble is more noticeable.
Unfortunately, GameGPU’s setup is likely not a practical method to play the GTA 6 PS5 Pro release. Input lag threatens to delay controller inputs for steering cars and aiming guns . Alternatives like the SmoovPlay app rely on PS Remote Play , but they face the same issues. Rockstar has yet to comment on when a native PC port might debut.

articles.txt:
GTA 6 has the same level of protection as some worldwide political leaders, with PlayStation practically being its head of security.
Both Rockstar Games and PlayStation have been banging on about how GTA VI plays best on the PS5 , and both companies are taking every measure imaginable to keep the game on consoles.
We live in an age where hackers and modders can use AI to make unofficial PC ports, which would be catastrophic for GTA VI in more ways than one.
To combat this, PlayStation has released a new PS5 firmware update that’s essential for playing GTA VI at launch.
Anyone who doesn’t download this new firmware will lose access to PSN , which is needed to verify if your copy of the game is legitimate.
This is because hacked consoles cannot be used online, so it should in theory prevent any copies of the game from being ripped and leaked online.
Many believe it’s a futile effort though. Despite action from console manufacturers, hacking is becoming easier every day thanks to AI tools.
We’ve seen it happen with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026). When GTA VI releases worldwide on November 19, there’s a good chance we’ll have an unofficial PC port later that week.
It’ll no doubt be motivated by there being no official way of playing the game on PC come launch day. The core playerbase for the Grand Theft Auto series exists on consoles, so like GTA V, Rockstar will likely wait a year or so to release a PC version itself.
Interestingly, it sounds like this might coincide with the launch of GTA VI: Online.
READ MORE: GTA 6 Online: Release date speculation, latest news and everything we know
An unofficial PC port of the game would be a PR nightmare, but it could at least tackle one of the biggest complaints regarding the game’s launch: the framerate.
GTA VI is confirmed to target 30fps at all times, meaning everyone who bought a shiny, new TV and PS5 Pro in preparation for the big day may have wasted their money.
Even the mighty PS5 Pro won’t display the game at 60fps, though depending on your TV you might be able to simulate the feeling .
Should an unofficial PC port surface, there’s a good chance modders will be able to unlock the framerate like they’ve done with other games, for example Bloodborne .
Don’t get too excited though. To play it yourself you’ll have to pirate a copy of the game which we wouldn’t recommend, and there’ll probably be a suite of technical problems that come with the unlocked framerate. If Rockstar felt 30fps was enough, it was for a good reason.
GTA VI launches worldwide on November 19, but unlocks in New Zealand later today.

articles.t: GTA 6 reviews award 99 Metacritic score, topping GTA 4 to become Rockstar's top-rated
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 Metacritic verdict is in, and reviews conclude it exceeds the loftiest expectations. On its release date, the title’s 99 Metascore beats Rockstar’s GTA 5, GTA 4, GTA 3, and Red Dead Redemption 2. It’s also tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the aggregator’s top game of all time.
articles.txt:
As leaked, the GTA 6 review embargo expired when the title unlocked in New Zealand at midnight local time. Scores quickly populated Metacritic , averaging 99 and making it Rockstar ’s highest-rated game ever. Critics praise the massive Leonida map while dismissing concerns about a lackluster story .
Currently, the aggregator shows exclusively positive scores. Players who survived the long buildup to launch must wait 36 hours following the GTA 6 release date to submit user ratings. Even so, journalists are impressed and have awarded it Universal Acclaim status.
Despite fears that Rockstar would limit access to avoid leaks , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick was anxious to read GTA 6 reviews. As it turns out, more than 140 outlets received Xbox or PS5 codes in recent weeks. After boasting about the studio’s past performance, Zelnick will welcome the latest Metacritic consensus.
ⓘ screenshot, Metacritic GTA 6 Metacritic score shown Jason and Lucia ’s crime epic edges out GTA 4 , which notched an average score of 98 in 1999. GTA 5 , GTA 3 , and Red Dead Redemption 2 are closely behind at 97. The game has also tied the 1998 N64 classic Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Metacritic’s highest-rated entry of all time .
Much larger than previous open-world maps , Leonida lives up to its promise, according to reviews. Each region has a unique feel, enhanced by an overhauled dynamic weather system . More buildings are explorable, addressing a popular fan request.
The fictional take on Florida can test the limits of Xbox and PS5 consoles. Although frame rates target 30 fps , release date performance impressions are reassuring. Digital Foundry measured sporadic dips below that mark, but the visuals generally remain smooth. Most importantly, controls are responsive even when rendering at below 60 fps.
When avoiding side activities, some GTA 6 reviews clock the time to complete Jason and Lucia’s story at around 60 hours. The overwhelming amount of content can stall the narrative’s pacing at times. Nevertheless, without revealing spoilers, the writing is compelling with unexpected twists.
Minor quibbles include a Vice City that's overly congested with cars and NPCs , which can slow missions. Regardless, Take-Two and Rockstar will be happy with the record-setting 99 GTA 6 Metacritic rating.

It’s been over a year since the rumor spread that Manni is playing the game’s female deuteragonist, Lucia Caminos. Obviously no one can deny her physical resemblance to the character.
The TGAs also played with fire in another way, as these nominations were announced days before GTA 6 launches. This creates an improper situation where a game can get votes before the public has a chance to play it.
This controversy is clearly and easily avoidable if the TGAs had simply waited a few days, but maybe they were looking for the attention.

articles.chapeau: From Justice's original score to radio stations hosted by Bad Bunny and Lana Del Rey, here's a guide to the music of "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
From the sun-soaked synth-pop of Vice City to surfing a sea of radio stations, music has always been an essential part of Rockstar Games' gritty, open-world franchise. And with Grand Theft Auto VI taking players back to Vice City, the sprawling soundtrack is shaping up to be just as ambitious as the game itself.
Rockstar has already revealed a 34-track album featuring artists like Travis Scott, Cardi B, and PinkPantheress, along with an original score composed by the French electronic duo Justice. Meanwhile, the game's fictional radio stations are bringing some familiar voices to the airwaves, including Robyn, Bad Bunny, and Lana Del Rey.
And that's just what we know so far. Ahead of GTA 6 's Nov. 19 release , we're keeping track of every confirmed song, artist, radio station, and celebrity DJ coming to Leonida. Consider this your unofficial guide to the sounds of Vice City.
Rockstar has announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , a 34-track collection of original music arriving Nov. 19, the same day as the game.
The album features an eclectic mix of artists and genres , from hip-hop heavyweights Travis Scott and Cardi B to country star Morgan Wallen and Puerto Rican singer Rauw Alejandro. There's even a collaboration between CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and French producer Etienne de Crécy. And somehow, someway, Morgan Wallen's single is the most-streamed track from the soundtrack on Spotify, with more than 25 million streams. Yung Lean, fight back!
"Sexy Magic" — CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Étienne de Crécy
"Flower in a Hurricane" — Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA & King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
"Overtown Lights" — Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes & Robert Glasper
Fans can listen to the available singles on Rockstar's official GTA 6 music website , where the album is also available to pre-save or pre-order on vinyl and CD.
The French electronic duo Justice, consisting of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay, is responsible for the original score of Grand Theft Auto VI .
Rockstar confirmed the news on Oct. 15 alongside the game's launch trailer , which features the debut of Justice's new single, "Flower in a Hurricane," featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and Australian psychedelic rock band King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard.
It's a fitting collaboration for a game returning to Vice City, a fictional playground known for its vibrant nightlife and electronic music. Justice's signature blend of distorted synths, disco, and dance music feels particularly suited to Rockstar's radiant criminal underworld.
The duo previously collaborated with Tame Impala on "Neverender" from their 2024 album Hyperdrama . The song won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2025 Grammys.
Rockstar has also confirmed that an official score album is on the way, although additional details, including its release date and tracklist, have yet to be announced.
The fictional radio stations are one of Grand Theft Auto 's most beloved features, and GTA 6 is bringing some major star power to the airwaves.
On Oct. 8, Rockstar unveiled six radio stations , each with its own musical identity and celebrity hosts. Among the biggest names are Bad Bunny, Robyn, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy, and members of Slayer.
Here's a breakdown of the confirmed stations and their hosts :
Bad Bunny is bringing the sounds of Puerto Rico to Vice City. Alongside singer RaiNao, the superstar hosts Cocoteo FM, a station dedicated to modern Latin music, including reggaeton and other Caribbean sounds.
A familiar name for longtime Vice City fans, Flash FM returns with Swedish pop icon Robyn and model Alex Consani behind the microphone. The station promises a steady stream of pop music and dance-floor favorites.
Country music gets its own corner of Leonida with Back Country Radio, hosted by Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey. In perhaps the most unexpected casting choice, Del Rey's husband, Jeremy Dufrene, also makes an appearance as the station's " roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and airboat captain ."
Afrobeats superstar Burna Boy teams up with DJ and producer Palms Trax for a station spotlighting amapiano, African classics, and other sounds from across the continent.
Metal fans aren't being left out. Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya host The Chamber , a station dedicated to heavy metal.

articles.txt:
Copied Clear your calendar, GTA 6 is coming! According to a new review leak, GTA 6's story length comes in at around 50 hours if you stick to the main missions and skip the side activities. That’s how long it reportedly takes to get through Jason and Lucia’s campaign. Trophy hunters, though, will need a lot more time. The PS5 platinum trophy reportedly needs around 200 hours, and some of that will be spent tracking down wildlife.
The estimate comes from Tom Henderson of Insider Gaming , based on impressions from media members who are reviewing the game ahead of release. He says the campaign has 100 missions spread across five chapters.
Fifty hours might sound short next to an earlier figure. Rockstar North co-lead Rob Nelson told The New York Times that his playthrough took around 80 hours, but that included optional quests in an open world full of distractions.
For comparison, GTA 5’s single-player campaign ran about 32 hours, while Red Dead Redemption 2 also landed around the 50-hour mark. GTA 6’s map, covering Vice City and its surrounding areas, is reportedly much bigger than either. One reason the story may not run longer is that crossing it in a supercar is much faster than doing it on horseback.
Completionists should plan for roughly 200 hours to earn the platinum on PS5. An earlier datamine found 55 PS5 trophies, including the platinum, and Henderson hints at a rare mythic achievement on Xbox, which would give Xbox players the same total.
There’s also a wildlife challenge. Like Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA 6 reportedly asks players to find and photograph 170 different animals across Leonida.
Every objective at launch is reportedly single-player or story-based. There’s no word yet on when a new GTA Online might arrive, but the launch build does contain code related to multiplayer modes.

articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj, 21, pleads guilty to cybercrimes related to the 2022 Rockstar hack and GTA 6 leaks.
articles.txt:
Arion Kurtaj, the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who first revealed Lucia to the world, has pleaded guilty to cybercrimes in relation to his 2022 hack of Rockstar . He also pleaded guilty to attempting to extort Rockstar, and to attacking workers at a facility where he was being detained after the hack.
Kurtaj, who is now 21, was 17 when he was initially taken into custody over the 2022 Rockstar hack. As he is from the U.K., he could not initially be named as a minor. He was also deemed unable to stand trial due to the severity of his autism, and was instead sent to be held indefinitely in a secure psychiatric facility . Now, as reported by the BBC , he has been deemed able to stand trial and has entered a guilty plea.
The 2022 hack resulted in the first major GTA 6 leak, as early gameplay footage was shared online. Here, we saw Jason and Lucia for the first time, as they held victims at gunpoint. These clips were shared under the online name TeaPotUberHacker. Rockstar refused to pay Kurtaj's ransom.
Crucially, this was our first confirmation that GTA 6 would star a female protagonist, a first in modern GTA games.
It would be over a year before Rockstar finally confirmed this itself, and even longer until we got an official gameplay reveal, which was only shared in August of this year.
It wasn't just the leaked material that brought attention to this hack in 2022, but also the method in which Kurtaj pulled it off. At the time, police were housing him in a hotel after he was apprehended for previous hacks, fearing he would be targeted by rival hackers. Using his hotel TV, an Amazon Fire Stick, and a Bluetooth mouse and keyboard, Kurtaj was able to breach Rockstar, taking gameplay clips and files.
Rockstar claims that the hack cost them $5 million to recover from. It further claimed that the Lucia reveal was being kept underwraps for the marketing campaign, something that Kurtaj's leaks spoiled.
However, it isn't just these crimes related to the hack that Kurtaj was facing. The BBC also notes that the 21 year old pleaded guilty to physical assaults, in relation to biting workers at the facility where he was being kept.
Kurtaj is awaiting his sentencing. It is unclear if his time at the secure facility will be taken into account should he recieve a custodial sentence.

articles.chapeau: The hacker behind 2022's GTA 6 leaks has pleaded guilty to a series of cyber attacks on Rockstar Games, Uber and more.
articles.txt:
The 21-year-old responsible for hacking Rockstar Games and leaking in-development GTA 6 footage in 2022 has pleaded guilty to a number of offenses.
The GTA 6 leaker was initially sentenced to an indefinite stay at a hospital due to his severe autism, but was more recently deemed fit for trial and moved to a regular prison earlier this January. On Monday, at the Woolwich Crown Court in South East London, he pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and a number of other companies, including Uber and EE/BT, in cyber attacks estimated to have caused £10m in damages.
At the time of his Rockstar hack - when he was between the ages of 16 and 17 - the leaker was already under police protection at a Travelodge hotel to keep him from rival hackers he had allegedly stolen Bitcoin from. Somewhat surprisingly, he then managed to hack the multi-billion dollar game maker with nothing but an Amazon Fire Stick, the hotel room's TV and a bluetooth-connected keyboard and mouse.
As the BBC reports , he also managed to break into the developer's Slack channels, before threatening to release the GTA 6 source code if Rockstar failed to contact him within the day. The leaker has yet to be sentenced.
Those 2022 leaks were quite substantial, too, revealing about an hour of unfinished gameplay and clueing the world in on Lucia's existence - the series' first female protagonist in years. Of course, those 2022 leaks shouldn't be confused with 2026's, which saw Cyberleek spill nuggets of nearly finished clips onto the internet, despite Rockstar's best efforts to keep GTA 6 a closely guarded secret.
"We recently suffered a network intrusion in which an unauthorised third-party illegally accessed and downloaded confidential information from our systems, including early development footage for the next Grand Theft Auto," Rockstar said at the time, before it had officially unveiled GTA 6. "At this time we do not anticipate any disruption to our live game services, nor any long-term effect on the development of our ongoing projects. We are extremely disappointed to have any details of our next game shared with you all in this way."
Four years later, GTA 6 is finally around the corner - you're probably already aware considering the marketing frenzy Rockstar's been drumming up .

Cybercriminals attempt to cash in on the hype around the game, luring fans with malware-laced downloads and ‘early access’ that doesn’t exist
On November 19 th , 2026, Grand Theft Auto VI will be released for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. But cybercriminals aren’t waiting for launch day. They have long been capitalizing on the hype around what’s arguably the most anticipated game of the decade, using fake leaks, malware-laced downloads, bogus online stores with rock-bottom prices, and fraudulent “early access” schemes to lure eager fans. Security experts at ESET expect such scams to proliferate as the release approaches and the holiday shopping season gets underway.
It’s easy to see why the franchise makes such an attractive lure: Grand Theft Auto is one of the most successful entertainment properties of all time, with more than 470 million units sold worldwide, according to Rockstar Games. Before taking a closer look at the scams tied to GTA VI, let’s establish what Rockstar has actually announced.
Pre-orders opened on June 25 th . According to Rockstar Games’ official pre-order announcement , the Standard Edition is priced at $79.99 in the United States, while the Ultimate Edition costs $99.99. Players who pre-order a digital copy have been able to pre-load the game since November 10 th .
What Rockstar has not announced is just as important, particularly with so many fraudulent offers circulating online: there is currently no official beta, playable demo, or early-access program that would let players start playing GTA VI before release day.
Nor has Rockstar announced a PC version, PC release date, or system requirements. This makes the official information a useful reality check: offers built around a supposed PC version, beta, demo, or early access are promising something Rockstar has never confirmed.
Scam type What to watch out for What attackers are after Credential phishing Fake Rockstar, PlayStation, Xbox, or Steam login pages Gaming-account credentials, passwords, and other personal information Fake beta or early access Invitations to register, log in, pay a fee, or download software to access a nonexistent GTA VI beta, demo, or early-access version Credentials, money, personal data, or malware installation Crypto scams Fake GTA VI giveaways, token airdrops, investment opportunities, or “VIP access” requiring cryptocurrency Cryptocurrency payments or access to victims’ crypto assets Fake stores and pre-orders Cloned or impersonating storefronts offering GTA VI copies, keys, bundles, or versions that have not been officially announced Payment-card details, personal information, or direct payments Malware delivery Fake launchers, leaked builds, beta installers, APKs, cracks, cheats, or preload tools Installation of infostealers, remote-access trojans, or other malware
The enormous anticipation for GTA VI has also made every new leak a magnet for attention. On August 18 th , an entity calling itself CyberLeek began releasing what it claimed was stolen GTA VI material, starting with two gameplay videos and an alleged map of Leonida. By October 12 th , TechWiser had cataloged 19 CyberLeek leaks. The material reportedly included in-game activities, clips featuring cars and aircraft, glimpses of locations and NPC behavior, and eventually story content showing part of Lucia’s prologue. Rockstar has publicly responded to the leaks, describing the release of unfinished material as “heartbreaking” and taking legal action in response.
But CyberLeek wasn't only chasing attention. The campaign also became intertwined with a cryptocurrency called $CYBERLEEK , launched on the Solana blockchain. CyberLeek introduced a token-based voting system in which holders could use $CYBERLEEK to vote on what material would leak next. BitOK , a blockchain analytics company, later investigated the associated on-chain activity and identified several channels through which money flowed into the operation, including token swap fees, voting payments, and direct payments on CyberLeek-linked websites. In one transaction sequence on August 27 th , the wallet that created the token claimed and sold liquidity-pool fees totaling 2,676.67 SOL (approximately $225,000 as of November 11 th , 2026). That said, BitOK cautions against equating individual blockchain flows with net profit or attributing all funds moving through these wallets to a particular person once they have mixed with money from other sources.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Cyberleek annonce son retour, un sondage est publié - GinjFo
articles.chapeau: GTA 6, Cyberleek annonce son retour après avoir promis d'arrêter les fuites. Un nouveau communiqué apparaît...
articles.txt:
Une nouvelle publication vient d’apparaître sur le canal Telegram directement référencé par le site de Cyberleek. Elle fait suite à l’annonce d’une fuite prévue pour le 28 octobre. Cyberleek propose un sondage intitulé “Next GTA 6 Leak?”, avec quatre possibilités :
Le sondage est apparu à 14 h 39 dans l’interface publique, après le message annonçant une nouvelle fuite pour le 28 octobre 2026.
L’affaire Cyberleek n’est peut-être pas terminée. Après avoir annoncé le 14 octobre dernier mettre fin à ses divulgations concernant GTA 6, le mystérieux auteur ou collectif semble avoir changé d’avis.
Un communiqué intitulé “ RETURN OF CL “, daté du 21 octobre, est apparu sur le site associé à ses précédentes publications. Le message promet un retour particulièrement offensif, avec de nouvelles révélations dont la nature reste inconnue.
Cette annonce intervient à moins d’un mois de la sortie du jeu. Le titre est attendu le 19 novembre 2026.
Cette affaire est étrange car rappelons que le 14 octobre dernier Cyberleek avait pourtant annoncé abandonner son projet de diffuser une prétendue version complète de GTA 6 . Son objectif financier, fixé à 30 millions de dollars de capitalisation pour sa cryptomonnaie, n’avait pas été atteint.
Dans son message de départ, il affirmait également renoncer à dévoiler la conclusion de l’histoire.
Mais tout vient de changer. Le nouveau communiqué annonce son retour et promet que les prochaines révélations seront détaillées.
Malgré cette déclaration, nous n’avons pas identifié de nouvelle séquence de gameplay pouvant être authentifiée indépendamment. Le site associé à Cyberleek continue de présenter les précédentes publications, notamment celles du 14 octobre.
Il faut également rappeler que plusieurs sites utilisent désormais le nom Cyberleek pour proposer de prétendues versions jouables contre paiement. Dans un tel contexte il est fortement recommandé d’étre très prudent.
Pour revenir à l’affaire de Cyberleek, elle est à surveiller car ce nom est à l’origine de la publication de plusieurs séquences attribuées à des versions de développement de GTA 6. Certaines ont été examinées par des médias spécialisés qui ont jugé que l’authenticité était probable.
Son éventuel retour pourrait donc s’accompagne de nouvelles divulgations serieuses.

articles.t: Cyberleek Shares GTA 6 Leak Of Naked Lucia
GTA 6 Nude Leak Clips Remain Unconfirmed as Hype Fuels Scams and a Crypto Grift | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Leaked nude GTA 6 clips remain unconfirmed and resemble a mod, while the hype fuels scams and a leaker's crypto coin grift.
articles.txt:
The Grand Theft Auto VI nude leaks are back in everyone's feeds and the reaction has gotten out of hand. It certainly doesn't help that Rockstar Games gave us a couple of shower scenes featuring Jason and Lucia in the official launch trailer . However, nothing has changed since we answered the real question . The leaked clips circulating online do not confirm full nudity in the finished game and look like a mod or a dev build.
The reason why we're bringing this up, again, has nothing to do with any of that either: it's that the frenzy is genuinely hurting the people taking part in it.
Think about who benefits every time the nude-leak story spikes. It is not fans. The hunt for a "leaked nude build" is exactly the bait that scammers and malware operators use since the download you are promised is never the game. It is a credential stealer or worse. The grift has gotten specific too. The same leaker is tying nude Lucia clips to a crypto coin , turning the hype into a direct payday. The more the search volume climbs, the more valuable that con becomes.
Who's to say it stops with Cyberleek? Given how much attention Cyberleek has gotten, the scheme could easily inspire countless copycats looking to take advantage of the group of eager fans.
There is a second problem with the pile-on. The thing everyone is reacting to is not confirmed. The several ratings boards across the world flag nudity and strong sexual content , but they do not tell you what any specific scene looks like. People are filling that gap with a leaked clip and calling it proof.
It is also worth a reality check on the shock itself. This is Grand Theft Auto . The series has had strip clubs, sex workers and crude humor for more than two decades. Nudity in a mature, adults-only GTA is not the scandal some reactions treat it as.
But again, none of this is harmless fun with no cost. We have watched the scam warnings spread so far that local news is now telling Miami to be careful . Every surge of nude-leak searching sends more people toward the exact traps those warnings describe. The footage will sort itself out on November 19 when the finished game is out. Unfortunately, the malware, the fake downloads and the crypto grift will not refund anyone in the meantime.
So by all means stay curious about what GTA 6 does with its adults-only rating. Just stop treating a mislabeled clip as the answer. Stop feeding an economy of scammers and grifters who are counting on the obsession.
Veteran · 607 rep Oct 20, 2026 The nude-leak discourse is not about nudity at all but rather for milking hyped-up fans of their money and their passwords.

articles.t: Le retour fracassant de Cyberleek et la fin annoncée des fuites sur GTA VI
articles.chapeau: La communauté du jeu vidéo a récemment été secouée par le retour inattendu de Cyberleek, cette entité anonyme qui avait pris l’habitude de divulguer des informations sensibles concernant les développements internes de Rockstar Games. Après plusieurs jours de silence relatif, ce leaker prolifique a réapparu avec une nouvelle plateforme web et des images inédites tirées
articles.txt:
La communauté du jeu vidéo a récemment été secouée par le retour inattendu de Cyberleek , cette entité anonyme qui avait pris l’habitude de divulguer des informations sensibles concernant les développements internes de Rockstar Games. Après plusieurs jours de silence relatif, ce leaker prolifique a réapparu avec une nouvelle plateforme web et des images inédites tirées de la mission finale de Grand Theft Auto VI .
Cette résurgence soudaine relance le débat éthique autour du piratage numérique et de la préservation de l’expérience joueur, tout en soulevant des questions persistantes quant aux motivations financières derrière ces actions spectaculaires. Les joueurs se demandent désormais si cette promesse de cessation définitive sera tenue ou s’il ne s’agit que d’un artifice marketing supplémentaire destiné à alimenter la spéculation autour des actifs cryptographiques associés.
Contrairement aux précédentes divulgations massives incluant des heures de gameplay brut, Cyberleek a opté pour une approche chirurgicale en publiant exclusivement des séquences de la dernière mission du titre très attendu. L’objectif affiché était de préserver le plaisir de découverte des futurs acheteurs tout en maintenant une pression médiatique maximale sur l’éditeur Take-Two Interactive.
Le leaker a explicitement mentionné détenir les fichiers relatifs à la conclusion narrative globale du jeu mais a choisi de ne pas les diffuser publiquement. Cette décision repose sur un calcul froid : publier la fin aurait causé des dommages irréparables à l’expérience utilisateur, tandis que la retenue actuelle permet de maintenir une forme de levier sans franchir le seuil critique de la ruine totale. La stratégie semble donc évoluer vers une nuisance contrôlée plutôt qu’une destruction ouverte, bien que les intentions profondes restent sujettes à caution.
À LIRE AUSSI : Neuf nouveaux jeux rejoignent le catalogue PlayStation Plus en octobre 2026
Les observateurs avisés ont rapidement noté la coïncidence temporelle entre ces nouvelles fuites et la promotion active d’un jeton numérique non-fongible baptisé « CL ». Cyberleek rejette catégoriquement toute accusation de spéculation financière pure, qualifiant le token de simple outil de collecte de dons destinés à financer ses activités futures.
Néanmoins, la corrélation directe entre la visibilité accrue apportée par les leaks et la capitalisation boursière volatile de ce meme-coin suggère une dynamique économique sous-jacente indéniable. Le leaker accuse les sceptiques, notamment certains créateurs de contenu YouTube, de cynisme aveugle face à sa prétendue démarche philanthropique envers la communauté des joueurs.
Il affirme agir pour protéger l’intégrité du divertissement contre les abus corporatifs, tout en exploitant paradoxalement l’écosystème spéculatif des cryptomonnaies pour soutenir son infrastructure technique coûteuse et complexe.
Au cœur de cette saga digitale se trouve un mystérieux projet parallèle, distinct de Rockstar, nécessitant des ressources matérielles considérables et une durée de développement estimée à plusieurs années. Pour concrétiser cette ambition, Cyberleek avait conditionné la publication d’une build complète du jeu au franchissement d’un palier symbolique de trente millions de dollars en capitalisation boursière du memecoin associé.
Cet objectif ambitieux n’a jamais été atteint, la valeur du jeton stagnants autour d’un million de dollars seulement. Face à cet échec financier cuisant, le leaker a annoncé honorer ses engagements contractuels implicites en refusant de télécharger anonymement plus de deux cents gigaoctets de données risquées.
Cette posture rigide masque mal une déception profonde vis-à-vis d’une audience jugée trop frileuse pour soutenir pleinement ses initiatives audacieuses et potentiellement lucratives.
À LIRE AUSSI : Rockstar garantit un développement plus rapide pour son prochain titre
Malgré les promesses solennelles de retrait définitif formulées dans le communiqué officiel, la prudence demeure de mise parmi les analystes du secteur vidéoludique. Avec encore plus d’un mois avant la sortie officielle de Grand Theft Auto VI , il paraît improbable que cette source d’information cesse totalement ses activités perturbatrices.
Le style rédactionnel particulier, marqué par une utilisation excessive de la voix passive et une structure syntaxique hachée, confirme la continuité de l’auteur principal derrière ces publications successives.

articles.chapeau: Some players are sure that the developers left a "signal" for the hacker.
articles.txt:
Some players are sure that the developers left a "signal" for the hacker.
Until recently, a hacker (or group) under the nickname Cyberleek actively published Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage online and also threatened to leak a build with the full story. However, he then reconsidered his decision and abandoned further leaks.
Soon after, Rockstar Games released the Grand Theft Auto VI trailer. Fans began to examine the footage, and a moment with a green car attracted attention. Those who closely followed the leaks immediately recognized it — it appeared in Cyberleek's videos.
1 / 2 Image source: Rockstar Games In the trailer, this model can be seen at the 0:46 mark — the driver is trying to escape from the police. Players believe that the appearance of this car is not a random coincidence. It is assumed that in this way, the developers from Rockstar Games sent a warning signal to Cyberleek to prevent further possible leaks.
Discussion participants recalled how in one of the Grand Theft Auto VI trailers, the opening scene with Jason began with him saying he was fixing some leaks (in the Russian subtitles, the phrase “fixing some leaks” was translated as “just fixing the roof,” so some Russian-speaking players might have missed the reference). During that period, hackers were leaking internal studio materials.
Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled for release on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles.
